definitions.gloss: to drink together; to exchange cups of sake
definitions.explanation: To share drinks with someone, each person pouring for the other. Implies a warm, convivial atmosphere of mutual drinking.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}と{酒|さけ}を{酌|く}み{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I shared drinks with a friend.

examples.japanese: {久|ひさ}しぶりに{旧友|きゅうゆう}と{杯|さかずき}を{酌|く}み{交|か}わした。
examples.english: After a long time, I exchanged cups of sake with an old friend.

examples.japanese: {夜遅|よるおそ}くまで{酒|さけ}を{酌|く}み{交|か}わしながら、{昔話|むかしばなし}に{花|はな}を{咲|さ}かせた。
examples.english: We shared drinks late into the night, reminiscing about the old days.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or elegant expression for drinking together. Implies mutual pouring and shared conversation. More refined than simply {飲|の}む.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒|さけ}を{酌|く}み{交|か}わす (to share sake)
- {杯|さかずき}を{酌|く}み{交|か}わす (to exchange cups)
- {語|かた}り{合|あ}いながら{酌|く}み{交|か}わす (to drink while talking together)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({酌|く}み{交|か}わす → {酌|く}み{交|か}わさない → {酌|く}み{交|か}わして). The {交|か}わす component indicates mutual action, like {話|はな}し{合|あ}う.
